title: Enforces link resolution for rule and gate items
description:
Declare `link-namespaces = ["enforces"]` on both the `rule` and `gate` item-kind configs, so an authored `enforces:@/rule/<self-id>` or `enforces:@/gate/<key>` label resolves to its target item through jit's existing generic link-resolution scan, the same mechanism that already resolves `satisfies:`, `per:`, and `mitigates:` links today. That generic scan iterates configured kinds and their declared link-namespaces with no kind name hardcoded, so no new resolution code is needed beyond the kind-config declaration once the deeper address form is available.

Also declare an `enforces` namespace in both jit's live project configuration and the `jit init` default configuration template for new repositories. The `enforces` namespace is not registered today, so an authored `enforces:` label would otherwise fail the namespace-registry validation rule even after everything else in this change lands.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `rule` and `gate` kinds declare `link-namespaces = ["enforces"]`; an authored `enforces:` label resolves to its target item through the existing generic link-resolution scan.
- [hard] REQ-02: `[namespaces.enforces]` is declared in the live project configuration and in the `jit init` default configuration template; an authored `enforces:` rule/gate link both resolves and passes the namespace-registry validation rule under `jit validate`.

Blast radius: the `rule` and `gate` item-kind configuration entries; the live project's namespace registry declaration; the `jit init` default configuration template.
